_meta.purpose: Reference pool for Gemini topic-matching only — NOT a source of eligibility truth. prerequisites.js / eligibility.js remain the only place eligibility is decided.
_meta.source: UNC Charlotte 2025-2026 Undergraduate Catalog, College of Computing and Informatics section (catalog pages 179-205), read directly from the PDF the user uploaded. This replaces the earlier ~27-course partial list, which was built from unreliable web fetches.
_meta.coverage: Every course code UNC Charlotte's own CCI degree/concentration/minor/certificate requirement pages list, across Bioinformatics & Genomics (BINF), Computer Science (ITSC/ITCS), Software & Information Systems (ITIS), and the School of Data Science (DTSC/SPOA). Also includes INFO and the MATH/STAT cognates CCI programs require, kept in a separate section since those departments aren't part of CCI. NOTE: this catalog excerpt is the 'degree requirements' section, not the full alphabetical 'course descriptions' section — a course that exists but isn't required/elective in any listed program won't appear here. Treat this as 'comprehensive relative to what a CCI student can actually use to satisfy a requirement,' not literally every course number CCI has ever assigned.
_meta.confidence: Codes and titles are transcribed directly from the uploaded catalog PDF (verifiable, not fabricated). Blurbs are my own paraphrase of the title + surrounding context, not verbatim catalog text. Two known corrections vs. the prior list: ITIS 4166 is 'Backend Application Development' (not 'Network-Based Application Development' — that's actually the title of the graduate equivalent, ITIS 5166); ITIS 3135 is 'Front-End Web Application Development' (not 'Web-Based Application Design and Development').
flaggedAmbiguities: Course numbered 1110 (Introduction to Computer Science Principles) appears with prefix ITCS in one place and is referenced as ITSC 1110 elsewhere in the same document — verify actual prefix before relying on it.
ITCS 3216 / ITIS 3216 'Introduction to Cognitive Science' appears under both prefixes on different pages — likely a genuine cross-listing, but not confirmed.

A couple of program-requirement tables print 'ITSC 3160 - Database Design and Implementation' where every other occurrence of that course uses 'ITCS 3160' — almost certainly a catalog typo, listed here under ITCS 3160.
ITCS 4131 appears only as a bare code in the Early Entry MS graduate-substitution table with no title given anywhere in this excerpt — omitted from the course list below rather than guessing a title.
INFO 2130 and INFO 3221 are named only as 'basic programming course' options for the Sports Analytics certificate prerequisite — no title given in this excerpt, so omitted below.
